customMethods.name: exportLotOperations
customMethods.script:
# implement your method here		
	''' 
 		Exports lot operation information and associated data such as asset and item links
 		 
 		Args: 
 			itemIds (list[int]): list of itemIds
 		Returns: 
 			exportInfo (dict) 
 			message (string): None if successful 
 		Updated: 
 			jz  10/14/25 created
 	'''
 	dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core') 
 	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_lot')
 	
	import java.lang
	
	lotOperationIds = [row['lotOperationId'] for row in self.view.custom.lotOperations.selectedData]
 	log.info("exportLotOperations() called with %s"%(lotOperationIds)) 
 	exportInfo = {}
 	
 	try:
		lotOperations = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperations({'lotOperationIdList': lotOperationIds}))
		lotOperationAssetLinks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperationAssetLinks({'lotOperationIdList': lotOperationIds}))
		lotOperationItemLinks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperationItemLinks({'lotOperationIdList': lotOperationIds}))
		
 		exportInfo['lotOperations'] = lotOperations
		exportInfo['lotOperationAssetLinks'] = lotOperationAssetLinks
		exportInfo['lotOperationItemLinks'] = lotOperationItemLinks
	 	
 		data = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))
 		fileName = 'Lot Operations Export ({}).json'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
	
		document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'lotOperationInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
		system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Lot Operations exported'})
 		 
 	except java.lang.Exception, e:
 		log.error("exportLotOperations() threw exception %s "%(e.cause))
 		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Lot Operations failed to export: %s'%e.cause})
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
'''
		Imports all lot operation info including asset links, and item links (kanoaOPS)
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Updated:
			10/14/25 JZ Created
	'''
	system.perspective.print('import los received')
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaLotImporter')
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	exportInfo = payload['exportInfo']['data']
		
	import java.lang
	if not (exportInfo.has_key('lotOperations') and exportInfo.has_key('lotOperationAssetLinks') and exportInfo.has_key('lotOperationItemLinks')):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Import data does not have the expected fields')
		return
		
	roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
	
	# add lot operation data
	lotOperationsAdded = 0
	lotOperations = exportInfo['lotOperations']
	lotOperationsIdMap = {}
	for lotOperation in lotOperations:
		lotOperationInfo = dict(lotOperation)
		lotOperationId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotOperationId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperations(({'lotOperationName': lotOperationInfo['lotOperationName']})))
		if lotOperationId:
			lotOperationsIdMap[lotOperationInfo['lotOperationId']] = lotOperationId
		else:
			newLotOperationId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotOperation(lotOperationInfo, userId)
			lotOperationsIdMap[lotOperationInfo['lotOperationId']] = newLotOperationId
			lotOperationsAdded += 1
	
	# Linking lot operations to assets
	lotOperationAssetLinks = exportInfo['lotOperationAssetLinks']
	assetsLinked = 0
	assetIdMap = {}
	for loaLink in lotOperationAssetLinks:
		loaLinkInfo = dict(loaLink)
		assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': loaLinkInfo['assetPath']}))
		if assetId: 
			assetIdMap[loaLinkInfo['assetId']] = assetId
			lotOperationAssetLinkId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotOperationAssetLinkId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperationAssetLinks({'assetId': assetId,'lotOperationName': loaLinkInfo['lotOperationName']}))
			if not lotOperationAssetLinkId:
				retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.linkLotOperationsAssets([assetId], [lotOperationsIdMap[loaLinkInfo['lotOperationId']]], userId)
				log.info('linkLotOperationsAssets returned %s, %s for %s at %s'%(retVal, msg, loaLinkInfo['lotOperationName'], loaLinkInfo['assetPath']))
				assetsLinked += 1
			else:
				log.info('Lot operation asset link already exists for %s at %s'%(loaLinkInfo['lotOperationName'], loaLinkInfo['assetPath']))
		else:
			log.info('AssetId not found for %s. Not adding asset link'%loaLinkInfo['assetPath'])
				
	# Linking operations to items
	lotOperationItemLinks = exportInfo['lotOperationItemLinks']
	itemsLinked = 0
	itemIdMap = {}
	for loiLink in lotOperationItemLinks:
		loiLinkInfo = dict(loiLink)
		if loiLinkInfo['itemId']:
			itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemPath': loiLinkInfo['itemPath']}))
			if itemId:
				retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.linkLotOperationsItems([itemId], [], [lotOperationsIdMap[loiLinkInfo['lotOperationId']]], loiLinkInfo['itemSourceId'], userId)
				itemsLinked += 1
			else:
				log.info('ItemId not found for %s. Not adding item link'%loiLinkInfo['itemPath'])
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'item not found')
		elif loiLinkInfo['itemClassId']:
			itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': loiLinkInfo['itemClassPath']}))
			if itemClassId:
				retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.linkLotOperationsItems([], [itemClassId], [lotOperationsIdMap[loiLinkInfo['lotOperationId']]], loiLinkInfo['itemSourceId'], userId)
				itemsLinked += 1
			else:
				log.info('ItemClassId not found for %s. Not adding item class link'%loiLinkInfo['itemClassPath'])
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'item class not found')
		else:
			log.info('No items found. Not adding item link')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': '%s lot operations, %s asset links, %s item links imported'%(lotOperationsAdded, assetsLinked, itemsLinked)})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetLinks.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemLinks.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.lotOperations.data")
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Lot Operations imported'}
